about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Missouri Department of Natural Resources (state park beach status)
channels.legal_basis: RSMo 640.080: the Department posts a state park swim beach "Swimming is Not Recommended" when the weekly samples' geometric mean exceeds 190 E. coli per 100 mL
channels.note: Weekly E. coli results and posting status of the state park swim beaches from Memorial Day to Labor Day, shown on the Department's page (each beach on its own page, with a GovDelivery sign-up) and published as the open data set "DNR Beaches Status" (data.mo.gov 945m-hi5h), which answered on 2026-11-15: 17 beaches, every one closed for the season, last samples Aug 31, 2026, highest geometric mean 17.2 (posting threshold 190), so no beach advisory stands while the beaches are closed. Bacteria, not sewage. The data set is not yet collected: both URLs are watched for availability only until an ingester reads it (before Memorial Day 2027).

channels.name: Missouri Department of Natural Resources (Water Pollution Control concern reports)

channels.name: Missouri Department of Natural Resources (HAB reports map)
